name: cherenkov-qa
description: AI-native API conformance testing — OpenAPI spec to Playwright tests, locally, privately, with zero vendor lock-in. Exposes HITL review, Validation Gate, drift detection, visual/perf testing, chat agents, and compliance tools over MCP.
author: moaidmoatasem

optional.name: CHERENKOV_JWT_SECRET
optional.description: JWT signing secret for MCP auth (auth.py). MUST be set when require_auth is enabled; the default is insecure.

auth.note: Enabled via MCPAuthMiddleware(require_auth=True); API keys also supported.

resources.name: HITL Pending Queue
resources.description: List of HITL items awaiting human review (hitl/v1 envelope).

resources.name: HITL Item Detail
resources.description: Single HITL item by ID (hitl/v1 envelope).

resources.name: Latest Validation Report
resources.description: Most recent validate/v1 ValidationReport from the Validation Gate.

resources.name: Validation Evidence Directory
resources.description: Listing of evidence files captured by the Validation Gate.

resources.name: Active Chat Sessions
resources.description: List of active chat sessions from the Chat Agent.

resources.name: CHERENKOV Integrity Gates
resources.description: Machine-readable description of the 6 REVIEW gates so agents can self-correct before calling verify_suite. Each entry explains what the gate checks, what a passing test must contain, and what cheat pattern it catches.

tools.name: hitl_list
tools.description: List HITL queue items matching the given status. Returns a hitl/v1 envelope.

status.description: Filter by status: pending | approved | rejected | ignored. Omit or pass null for pending.

tools.name: hitl_approve
tools.description: Approve a pending HITL item. Returns a hitl/v1 envelope.

item_id.description: ID of the HITL item to approve.

tools.name: hitl_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending HITL item. Returns a hitl/v1 envelope.

item_id.description: ID of the HITL item to reject.

tools.name: verify_suite
tools.description: Run the 6-gate integrity check on an AI-generated test suite and return a VerificationReport (verify/v1). Suggest-only — never auto-applies fixes.

suite_path.description: Path to a .spec.ts file to verify (must be within working directory).

suite_inline.description: Raw TypeScript test code to verify inline.

spec_source.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec for oracle derivation. Defaults to stub/openapi_3_1.yaml.

scenario_id.description: Scenario identifier used in finding IDs.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH). Default: POST.

tools.name: verify_system
tools.description: Probe a live server against its OpenAPI spec; return spec-drift divergences as a VerificationReport (verify/v1). Offline by default — no LLM required.

base_url.description: Base URL of the live server to probe (e.g. https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3).

spec_source.description: Path or HTTP URL to the OpenAPI spec JSON/YAML. Omit for built-in Petstore demo.

use_llm.description: If true, use the LLM Skeptic (requires Ollama). Default: false (offline mode).

tools.name: check_suite
tools.description: Static integrity check of a candidate test suite against a baseline: catches WEAKENED, DELETED, and HALLUCINATED assertions (`cherenkov check-suite`). Fast, offline, no execution.

candidate_path.description: Path to the candidate test suite (.py or .ts) to check.

candidate_inline.description: Raw test code to check inline (when the file isn't on disk yet).

baseline_path.description: Path to the known-honest baseline suite. Required for WEAKENED and DELETED detection.

spec_path.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (YAML/JSON). Required for HALLUCINATED detection on Python suites.

fail_on_finding.description: Report verdict 'fail' if any integrity violation is found.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Probe a live server against its OpenAPI spec and return spec-drift divergences (`cherenkov verify`). Offline by default — no LLM required. Supports coverage and health-score reports.

base_url.description: Base URL of the live server to probe (e.g. https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3).

spec_source.description: Path or URL to the OpenAPI spec JSON/YAML. Omit for the built-in Petstore demo.

use_llm.description: Use the LLM Skeptic (requires Ollama). Default: false.

allow_mutations.description: Allow happy-path probes for POST/PUT/DELETE. Default: false.

identifiers.description: JSON file path or inline JSON mapping path parameters to known valid values.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate Playwright E2E tests from an OpenAPI spec (`cherenkov generate`). Returns generated test code inline, or writes files when output_dir is given.

spec_path.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML) to generate tests for.

output_dir.description: Directory to write generated test files to. Omit to return code inline.

repair.description: Run the generate→review→repair loop. Default: true.

max_attempts.description: Max repair attempts per scenario (1-10, default 3).

tools.name: validate_run_gate
tools.description: Run the Validation Gate and return a validate/v1 ValidationReport. Suggest-only.

tools.name: policy_list
tools.description: List policy allow/block rules from cherenkov-policy.json.

tools.name: policy_reload
tools.description: Reload cherenkov-policy.json from disk without restarting the server.

tools.name: visual_diff_baseline
tools.description: Run visual snapshot regression and UI matching checks.

tools.name: visual_diff_baseline_enhanced
tools.description: Run comprehensive visual snapshot regression with baseline management, configurable diff thresholds, pixel/structural/auto comparison modes, and custom report paths.

target_url.description: Optional target URL for visual testing

comparison_mode.description: Comparison mode: pixel, structural, or auto

tools.name: run_k6_perf
tools.description: Run K6 performance load testing and latency analysis.

use_ml.description: Enable ML latency anomaly detection (default: false).

traffic_file.description: HAR or traffic log file path (optional).

tools.name: query_rag_index
tools.description: Query the SQLite RAG index for test historical artifacts.

tools.name: export_jira_ticket
tools.description: Suggest-only Jira export for failed validation items or custom summary/description.

item_id.description: Validation item ID (optional if summary and description provided).

tools.name: export_linear_ticket
tools.description: Suggest-only Linear export for failed validation items.

tools.name: export_github_ticket
tools.description: Suggest-only GitHub issue export for failed validation items.

tools.name: auto_heal_code
tools.description: Generate a suggested code patch for a failed validation item. Suggest-only.

tools.name: scan_mena_compliance
tools.description: Run the MENA compliance localization and data residency checks.

tools.name: scan_mena_compliance_enhanced
tools.description: Run targeted MENA compliance checks (SAMA CCSF / Egypt CBE FinCSF) against a live API.

tools.name: validate_governance_certification
tools.description: Validate a governance certification ID against quality standards.

validation_criteria.description: Validation criteria or standards to check against

tools.name: report_compliance_findings
tools.description: Return structured compliance findings, filterable by severity and endpoint.

severity.description: Filter by severity: high, medium, low, or all

tools.name: chat_query_verdicts
tools.description: Query recent test verdicts from the Reflector.

tools.name: chat_query_idioms
tools.description: Query learned idiom patterns from the Reflector.

tools.name: chat_explain_divergence
tools.description: Explain a divergence using the Knowledge Mesh GraphRAG.

tools.name: chat_run_test
tools.description: Plan test scenarios for a specific endpoint (suggest-only, does not execute).

endpoint.description: API endpoint to plan tests for.

tools.name: run_conformance_check
tools.description: Run cherenkov validate against a target URL and return the report summary.

tools.name: get_last_report
tools.description: Return the most recent .cherenkov/report.json without triggering a new run.

tools.name: list_drift_findings
tools.description: Return structured spec-drift findings from the last conformance run.

severity.description: Filter by severity: high | medium | low. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_tightening_suggestions
tools.description: Return OpenAPI spec tightening suggestions for a specific endpoint.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Natural-language explanation of a specific drift finding using the LLM.

tools.name: mcp_registry_list
tools.description: List all MCP servers registered in the mesh registry.

tools.name: mcp_registry_publish
tools.description: Register an external MCP server with the mesh registry.
JSON list of tool definitions.

tools.name: cherenkov/audit-test-file
tools.description: Audit a test file for integrity issues: weakened assertions, tautological checks, spec mismatches, and AI test-cheating patterns. Returns a verdict (PASS/WEAK/FAIL), an integrity score, specific issues with line numbers, and a SHA-256 certificate if the score is >= 0.90. Call this before committing AI-generated test code.

test_content.description: Raw content of the test file to audit

agent_id.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent

tools.name: cherenkov/check-assertion
tools.description: Quickly check whether a single test assertion line is strong or weak. Returns 'strong', 'weak', or 'tautological' with a brief explanation. Use this for real-time CodeLens-style feedback during test authoring.

tools.name: cherenkov/suggest-spec-fix
tools.description: Given an integrity issue found in a test file, suggest a spec-anchored fix. Returns the corrected assertion line and a plain-English explanation of why the original is problematic and how the fix resolves it.

original_line.description: The problematic test line to fix

issue_type.description: The type of integrity issue identified

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status code from the OpenAPI spec (if applicable)
